timing: Engineering amendment after current/historical scoring; no outcomes, strengths, current values or historical scores were retuned.
frozen_anchor: Production integration must load a versioned, persisted rank-value curve. Do not refit that curve whenever someone debuts or loses eligibility; that would reintroduce a debut discontinuity through calibration membership.
missing_source: Absence from a later list is not proof of graduation and must not delete archived evidence or assign zero. Retain the last supported ranking-policy estimate and disclose stale/missing evidence pending an explicit source update.
graduation: When graduation is explicitly confirmed, save the last ranking-policy value and career exposure at that event. Transition toward the supported MLB fundamental estimate using only additional observed exposure: w=delta/(delta+K). Value=(1-w)*last_policy_value+w*MLB_estimate. This is an unvalidated continuity policy, not a calibrated market-price model. At delta0, value is exactly the prior policy value, regardless of eligibility metadata.
evidence: While listed, source/model information may overlap. After confirmed graduation, only new exposure controls transition strength; do not recount all earlier evidence as a new observation. Role changes with incompatible PA/IP cannot share an exposure counter. No unsupported two-way graduation estimate.
